adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, `edit()` sets `categoryId` from `this.get('host.category.id')`. If `host.category` is missing (e.g., category deleted or not hydrated), `categoryId` becomes null/undefined. Then `save()` always does `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')`, and the server-side `save_host` in `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` coerces a blank `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id`. So an admin editing only the hostname can unintentionally reset the posting category to Uncategorized.
